subject: math

hotspots.label: Equivalent pair
hotspots.description: Two circles shaded with different slices but the same total amount — 1/2 and 2/4.
hotspots.positionHint: The two fraction circles side by side with matching shaded areas.
hotspots.function: Shows two fractions naming the same amount.

hotspots.label: Scale rule
hotspots.description: Multiplying both the numerator and denominator by the same number builds an equal fraction.
hotspots.positionHint: The ×n control attached to the left circle.
hotspots.function: Generates equivalent fractions by scaling both numbers.

hotspots.label: Simplify
hotspots.description: Dividing both numbers by a common factor reduces the fraction to simplest form.
hotspots.positionHint: The simplify control attached to the right circle.
hotspots.function: Reduces a fraction by dividing out a common factor.

visualStyleNotes: Fractions And Ratios, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. Two clean fraction circles on a mat with matching shaded slices, plus scale and simplify controls. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Fraction circles: warm paper white discs (roughness ~0.5) with ink-grey seams. Filled slices: warm amber (roughness ~0.45). Fraction labels under each. Sliders: soft warm-grey rails with amber knobs. Mat: soft warm-grey. No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: equivalent fractions as two circles with matching shaded amounts that restyle as the scale/simplify controls act.

GEOMETRY: Two fraction circles (radius ~0.8) side by side at x ≈ −0.9 and +0.9, y ≈ 0.25. Left: 1/2 with 1 slice filled. Right: 2/4 with 2 slices filled. Both share the same shaded fraction of the disc. A Scale slider (top) multiplies both circles' parts (×2, ×3...) redrawing seams while preserving shaded area. A Simplify control reduces a 6/8 third circle to 3/4 by dividing both by 2.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) fraction circles; (2) scale/simplify controls; (3) fraction labels.

CAMERA: head-on, slightly above, from +z fits both circles; labels legible. Budget 6-11k triangles. Named nodes: Circle_Left, Circle_Right, Slice_Seams, FilledParts, ScaleSlider_Knob, SimplifyButton, FractionLabels. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
